reason: Observable data/model-discrimination gate for alternative explanations of apparent dark matter, apparent cosmic acceleration and gravity; observational data are not declared proof of a unique microphysical ontology

entries.observable_or_test: CMB spectrum, lensing and cosmological benchmark
entries.verified_result_or_debate: Planck 2018 published 2020 6-parameter LCDM matches acoustic peaks/polarization/lensing; dark sectors are effective model components, not identified microstates
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: All candidates must explain peak pattern, perturbation growth, lensing and consistency with recombination

entries.verified_result_or_debate: McGaugh–Lelli–Schombert 2016 show tight relation of observed acceleration to baryonic prediction at 2693 locations in 153 galaxies
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Apparent excess attraction must reproduce mass-discrepancy acceleration regularity, scatter and morphology

entries.verified_result_or_debate: Clowe et al 2006 show lensing gravitational potential peak separate from dominant X-ray gas in Bullet Cluster; other cluster mergers show similar effect
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: A baryonic-only simple radial enhancement is not enough; alternatives must explain offset lensing mass concentrations and dynamics
entries.status: strong cluster constraint; physical interpretation model-dependent

entries.verified_result_or_debate: GW170817 + GRB170817A tightly constrain gravity-wave speed relative to light at detected frequencies, restricting many modified-gravity models
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Any effective gravitational propagator must pass multi-messenger speeds and local limits without artificial frequency loopholes

entries.verified_result_or_debate: DESI DR2 2025-2026 distance measurements, multi-redshift expansion, published data products
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Distinguish geometric/expansion observational quantities from a uniquely inferred dark-energy substance
entries.status: strong measured distance constraints, interpretation model dependent

entries.observable_or_test: DES full Y6 multi-probe dynamic DE
entries.verified_result_or_debate: DES Y6 with low-z SN+BAO+3x2pt finds 2.2-2.3 sigma dynamical DE preference; adding CMB about 3 sigma (dataset/model-dependent)
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Treat varying effective w(z) as a hypothesis; preserve systematics and cross-probe checks

entries.verified_result_or_debate: 2026 Bayesian comparison finds low/high redshift magnitude offset preferred over some smooth dynamical-DE alternatives, not a blanket disproof
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Dark-energy apparent evolution may be data calibration or inference issue, not a new physical fluid

entries.observable_or_test: Verlinde apparent dark gravity lensing preliminary positive
entries.verified_result_or_debate: Brouwer et al KiDS+GAMA lensing isolated galaxies (33,613 objects) matched selected EG predictions, but made LCDM-related assumptions and restricted spherical/isolation regime
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Not a complete covariant cosmology or conclusive absence of dark particles

entries.verified_result_or_debate: Lelli, McGaugh and Schombert 2017 finite galaxy EG variant required low stellar mass-to-light and predicted radius-correlated residuals not observed
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Avoid calling emergent entropic dark gravity validated from a first lensing agreement

entries.observable_or_test: Causal-set everpresent Lambda early-universe isotropy critique
entries.verified_result_or_debate: Barrow 2007 CMB isotropy constrains model stochastic Lambda fluctuations, potentially too small for late acceleration
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Causal-network dark energy proposal must handle CMB, not just order-of-magnitude Lambda

entries.verified_result_or_debate: 2025 MNRAS Letters favors timescape on selected Pantheon+ analysis; other calibration/BAO/SN methods reach different inferences
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Apparent acceleration from clock calibration must explain SN + BAO + Planck, not only one supernova fit

entries.verified_result_or_debate: Oxford June 2026 reports one supernova analysis questioning acceleration and an independent competing paper confirming it
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Do not turn dark-energy mechanism uncertainty into claim expansion/acceleration observations vanish; model dependence matters

entries.observable_or_test: Cosmological perturbation viability of no-DM AeST
entries.verified_result_or_debate: Skordis–Zlosnik 2021 fits observed CMB and linear matter power spectra under theory assumptions
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Follow with nonlinear lensing/cluster/pulsar/effective-field stability tests
entries.status: theoretical fit, not proof alternative correct

entries.verified_result_or_debate: May 2026 EPJC analysis finds conditional evolving-DE preference may be driven by LRG1-2 tracers, modest 1.1–2.3 sigma late-time-only
entries.what_causal_step_must_explain: Beware overclaiming 4sigma total combination as settled physical dynamics; test calibrations and priors
